items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Buster Bailey, Herman Autrey, and Vic Dickenson.

ctx.x: Russell Smith. Well Russell had just left here, and I walked in there without a rehearsal, and they had been rehearsing all week now. This is a good story. Doc and his band, Garvin Bushell was on, you know (unintelligible) the sax, and Buster Bailey was there playing the alto. Buster was the only one left out of the old band.
Ba ba ba bi di di, let me see can I think of some more. I knew all the guys in the band, because I worked with them before.
